plan.name: Check countertop first, then fridge and cabinets for lettuce, cool and place on countertop.
plan.strategy: Check the countertop first for any existing lettuce, then search the fridge and cabinets if it is not found, cool it if necessary, and place it back on the countertop.
steps: Check countertop 1 to countertop 3 for any existing lettuce.
If lettuce is not found on the countertop, check fridge 1 for lettuce.
If lettuce is not found in the fridge, systematically search cabinets 1 to 6.
Once lettuce is found, take it and check if it is already cool.
If lettuce is not cool, place it in the fridge to cool it.
Once lettuce is cool, return it to a countertop (e.g., countertop 1) and place it there.
